compute_sacrebleu_score: compute BLEU scores for machine translation predictions against references using Sacrebleu
test_sacrebleu_compute: test the Sacrebleu compute method with predictions and references to produce BLEU scores
review_sacrebleu_class: review the Sacrebleu class that wraps sacrebleu corpus BLEU computation with smoothing and tokenization options
summarize_sacrebleu_info: summarize the Sacrebleu _info method that returns metric metadata including features and citation
build_sacrebleu_metric: build a HuggingFace evaluate metric that computes reproducible BLEU scores with configurable tokenization and smoothing
